review_evidence: README describes a compile-time checked dimensional-analysis framework with SI/extra-SI/Imperial units and typed physical quantities, explicitly intended to support formal verification of physics statements.
13 of 40 Lean files contain 252 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.

LeanUnits/Framework/Units/Lemmas.lean proves the algebra of units/equivalence and the library includes conversion/dimension results, providing reusable formal interfaces rather than only executable application code.
summary: Reviewed lean-units; retain its dimensional-analysis structures, unit/quantity APIs, and theorem library.
